pixel_coords: x right, y DOWN, original resolution, origin top-left

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; background identical across frames apart from the ball and its shadow)
camera.view: fronto-parallel view of a flat building facade; ball falls in a plane parallel to the wall, so one metres-per-pixel scale applies

football.description: American football (dark brown leather, white stripes near each tip), the only moving object; right side of the frame in front of the blue corrugated wall, x ~1036
football.reference_point: mask centroid (cx, cy) = proxy for the object's origin (centre of a symmetric rigid ball)
football.orientation: long axis roughly vertical throughout; ball tumbles slowly (white stripe at the bottom tip in frame 0, at the top tip by ~frame 20+)
football.motion: starts essentially at rest at frame 0 (y 228.5 -> 229.7 between frames 0 and 1) and falls straight down with steadily increasing speed; horizontal drift < 2 px. Per-frame dy grows ~3.3 px/frame each frame (vertical pixel displacement frame 30->31 ~96 px).

events.event: release / start of fall (ball at rest at top)
ball passes level of top landing platform underside (y~640)
last frame; ball bottom (y=1763) reaches the base of the wall / ground line (~1765-1770); no bounce or impact visible within the clip

fire_escape_stairs.description: yellow steel staircase with three landings, left/centre

top_landing.description: upper yellow landing with orange mesh floor

middle_landing.description: middle landing in front of the middle door

bottom_landing.description: ground-level landing at the stair foot

door_top.note: lower part hidden behind landing railing

door_middle.description: yellow door with dark glass panel, middle storey

door_bottom.description: yellow door with dark glass panel, ground storey

window.description: square window with yellow frame, upper left

beige_panel.description: sky/landscape-coloured rectangle at right edge (gap in wall)

wall.description: blue corrugated metal facade, fills background

static_extents_reliability: read off a 100 px grid, about +/-5 px
